subject: gk
question:
Read the following about the Green Revolution in India.

A. The green revolution in India refers to a period when Indian Agriculture was converted into an industrial system due to the adoption of modern methods and technology such as the use of HYV seeds, tractors, irrigation facilities, pesticides and fertilizers.

B. It was funded by the US and the Indian Government and the Ford and Rockefeller Foundation.

Identify the CORRECT statement/statements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Green Revolution in India marks a period of significant agricultural transformation in the country.
 
• This transformation was characterized by the adoption of new technologies, including High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds, tractors, irrigation facilities, pesticides, and fertilizers.
 
• The revolution aimed at increasing agricultural productivity to make India self-sufficient in food grains.
 
• The initiative was financially supported by the Indian government, the United States, and international organizations such as the Ford and Rockefeller Foundations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **High Yielding Variety (HYV) Seeds**

 
 
• HYV seeds are a type of seed that has been specifically bred to produce more crops per acre compared to traditional seeds.
 
• They were a key component of the Green Revolution and helped significantly increase agricultural production.
 
 
 
• **Tractors and Mechanization**
 
 
• The use of tractors and other machinery helped speed up farming processes and reduce the need for manual labor.
 
• This mechanization was crucial in transforming Indian agriculture into an industrial system.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation Facilities**
 
 
• The development and expansion of irrigation facilities ensured a more reliable water supply for crops, which is essential for high agricultural productivity.
 
• Improved irrigation helped mitigate the effects of drought and other water-related issues.
 
 
 
• **Pesticides and Fertilizers**
 
 
• The use of chemical pesticides and fertilizers helped protect crops from pests and diseases, and provided essential nutrients to the soil.
 
• These inputs were critical in achieving the high yields associated with the Green Revolution.
 
 
 
• **Ford and Rockefeller Foundations**
 
 
• These foundations played a significant role in providing financial and technical support for the Green Revolution.
 
• They helped fund research and development of new agricultural technologies and practices.
